comment: Neutral MAIN chains (issue #19): Tirion Fordring, Pamela Redpath and Linken. No quest is limited to a race, so both factions see each chain (chain race 'Neutral'). Chains only: no saga route holds them. Every name, level, giver and point comes from the facts.

chains.name: Tirion Fordring
chains.summary: Tirion Fordring in the Eastern Plaguelands gives three tasks, then the trail runs on to Artist Renfray, Myranda the Hag and Highlord Taelan Fordring.

chains.name: Pamela Redpath
chains.summary: Marlene Redpath or Jessica Redpath starts the search for Pamela Redpath in the Eastern Plaguelands. The trail runs through Chromie and Carlin Redpath to the battle of Darrowshire.

chains.name: Linken
chains.summary: A wrecked raft and a small pack in Un'Goro Crater start the trail. It runs through Linken, Donova Snowden, Gaeriyan, J.D. Collie and Eridan Bluewind and ends with Linken at Marshal's Refuge.
